entities.name: Urease beta subunit
observations: The 102-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to curated Bordetella urease beta-subunit proteins, including UniProt P0A4R2 and P0A4R3.
The sequence contains the Urease_beta Pfam domain PF00699.26 spanning residues 3-99.
This is an accessory structural subunit of the urease complex; it is not the standalone catalytic urease subunit.

entities.name: Urea hydrolysis
observations: Urease catalyzes urea + 2 H2O + H+ → hydrogencarbonate + 2 NH4+; Rhea RHEA:20557 and EC 3.5.1.5.

The reaction is carried out by the multimeric urease complex containing beta, alpha, and accessory components; the beta subunit supports complex assembly/function rather than providing the principal catalytic site.

entities.name: Urea degradation
observations: The protein is annotated in nitrogen metabolism and the urea degradation pathway.
